name: multi
description: Several models on the same question at once — the host model's reviewer roles, OpenAI Codex, OpenCode and any OpenRouter model — reconciled into one report. Review code, check whether the work is actually finished, brainstorm wide, or ask all of them something.

interface.shortDescription: Several models review the same code; disagreement is the signal
interface.longDescription: Code review, done-check and brainstorming by several model families at once — Codex, OpenCode, OpenRouter, Gemini and the host model's own reviewer roles — judged into one report that says who found what and who was missing.
